title: ChatGPT discovery measurement worksheet
evidenceBasis: Primary-source documentation review plus an original proposed workflow; not merchant performance data.

supports: Aggregate mentions, website clicks and discovery topics
Availability thresholds and no sharing of user conversations or Business Agent chats

privacyAndRights: Original blank fields and brief paraphrases with source links. No customer rows, private research identifiers, provider lineage or source text archive.
rules: A null value is not zero.
Use a specific missingness reason only with evidence.
Do not divide incompatible populations or periods.
A session conversion numerator counts sessions with a qualifying paid order, not raw orders.
Record cost definitions and avoid double counting.
No private merchant records should be added to a public copy.
reuse: Original worksheet may be reused with attribution to MarketplaceBeta Research and this article. Third-party source content retains its own rights.
limitations: No Business Hub account or export inspected.
No observed conversions, profit, adoption or causal effects.
